```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinythemes)
```

```{r}
gapminder<-read_csv("C:/Users/jk_ic/OneDrive/Desktop/BIS15L_W2026_Group9/Gapminder/gapminder.csv")
#gapminder
```



```{r}
ui <- dashboardPage(
  
  dashboardHeader(title = "Countries Throughout The Years"),
 
  dashboardSidebar(
    
    selectInput("filter",
              "select country",
              choices = unique(gapminder$name),
              selected = "Afghanistan"),
    
    selectInput("y",
              "Select Variable",
              choices = c("life_expectancy",
                          "Co2_emissions",
                          "population",
                          "gdp"),
              selected = "population"), 
  
  sliderInput("Range",
              label = "choose years",
              min = min(gapminder$year, na.rm = T),
              max = max(gapminder$year, na.rm = T),
              value = c(1915, 2022),
              step = 1,
              sep = "")
),
  
  dashboardBody(
    
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = textOutput("plot1_title"),
        status = "info",
        solidHeader = T,
        width = 6,
        plotOutput("plot1", height = "500px")
      ),
      box(
        title = "USA throughout the years",
        status = "danger",
        solidHeader = T,
        width = 6,
        plotOutput("plot2", height = "500px")
      )
    )
  )
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$plot1_title <- renderText(paste(input$filter, "throughout years"))
  
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    
    gapminder %>% 
      filter(name == input$filter,
             year >= input$Range[1],
             year <= input$Range[2]) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]], na.rm=T))+
      scale_y_log10()+
      geom_line(color= "yellow")+
      geom_point(na.rm=T, shape=1, color= "blue")+
      scale_x_continuous(limits = input$Range)+
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1, size = 25),
            axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 20))+
      labs(x="Year")
    })
  
  
  output$plot2<-renderPlot({
    gapminder %>% 
      filter(name=="USA",
             year >= input$Range[1],
             year <= input$Range[2]) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]]))+
      geom_line(aes(color="tomato"))+
      geom_point(shape=1, na.rm=T, color="blue")+
      scale_y_log10()+
      scale_x_continuous(limits = input$Range)+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text( hjust=1, size=25),
            axis.text.y = element_text (hjust=1, size=20), 
            legend.position= "none")+
      labs(title="USA throughout years",
           x="Years",
           y=input$y)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
